prompt: Implement src/expr.js exporting `evaluate(source, vars = {})` for a small arithmetic language, without using eval or Function. Numbers (integers and decimals like 2.5 or .5), variables (identifiers [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, looked up in vars; an unknown variable throws Error `unknown variable: <name>`), binary + - * / % and ^ (power, right-associative, binds tighter than unary minus so -2^2 is -4), unary minus and plus, parentheses, and whitespace anywhere. Usual precedence: ^ above unary minus above * / % above + -; * / % + - are left-associative. Division by zero throws Error `division by zero`. Any syntax error throws an Error whose message starts with `syntax error`. Write your own tests in test/ and run `node --test` (it finds test/*.test.mjs; on Node 24 `node --test test/` fails because a directory argument is not accepted).
